fields.label: Jira Data Center host
fields.description: Jira Data Center host (and context path if any), e.g. jira.example.com or jira.example.com/jira — no scheme (Crogl adds https://). Do NOT include /rest/api/2.

fields.label: Personal Access Token (PAT)
fields.description: Jira Data Center Personal Access Token, created under Profile -> Personal Access Tokens (Jira 8.14+). Injected server-side as the Authorization: Bearer header.

fields.label: Skip TLS verification
fields.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Enable for on-prem installs presenting a self-signed or internal-CA certificate.
